questions.question: Find direction of current in position I and position II in the given diagram:

Clockwise in position I as well as position II.
Anticlockwise in position I and clockwise in position II.
Anticlockwise in position I as well as position II.
questions.explanation:
• Position I :
As the loop enters the magnetic field region, the magnetic flux through the loop increases. The induced current must oppose this increase. Applying Fleming’s right hand rule, the current is found to be anticlockwise. 

• Position II :
As the loop moves out of the magnetic field region, the magnetic flux linked with it decreases. The induced current now tries to maintain the flux, so its direction reverses compared to position I. Hence, the current is clockwise.
